statement: Recorded beside the sealed freeze rather than inside results.json: freeze.json is sealed and is not edited after the run, and the sealed module does not emit a deviation field (see proposal.json:B5-D4). Nothing here changes a frozen parameter, threshold, seed, metric, cost treatment or clause; each item states what was done and why.

deviations.as_run: The engine verdict was taken with --branch AUCTION_V2 (contract ADMISSION-AUCTION-v2) rather than the assignment's suggested --branch AUCTION.
deviations.cause: AUCTION_CONTRACT v1 and BUILTIN_CONTRACTS["AUCTION"] were kept unchanged so the existing AUCTION fixtures keep their verdicts; the corrected contract is registered additively as AUCTION_V2 with the two operator-authorized changes.
deviations.effect_on_verdict: none: the manifest is DATA_VALID with no findings under v2, and DATA_VALID under v1 as well (the v1 clause admits it as before).
deviations.frozen: the assignment wording '--branch AUCTION'; the frozen contract text itself is unchanged.

deviations.as_run: The entry-print extraction (book replay) ran BEFORE freeze.json was sealed; the manifest and the freeze therefore hash it.
deviations.cause: The entry print is a quote observation, not an outcome, and the admission manifest must hash every retained object it declares. No outcome quantity was computed before the seal: no Closing Cross price was read, no return, no cost-adjusted figure and no P&L.

deviations.as_run: The NOII cadence bound is stated over the signal interval (15:50:00-15:55:00 ET) at 15 s = 1.5x the 10 s dissemination period this session shows, not over the whole 10-minute window at 10 s.
deviations.cause: The first draft bounded the whole window at 10 s and failed every symbol, because the feed's own period is 10.0-10.14 s; a bound below the feed's designed cadence certifies nothing. The sealed certificate states both the bound and the interval, and the whole-window cadence is reported beside it as a diagnostic.
deviations.effect_on_verdict: turns a vacuous check into 'no missed dissemination cycle'. All 2465 denominator symbols pass; the bound is not outcome-related.

deviations.as_run: The reconstruction gate is UNEVALUABLE as specified (exchange Near/Far band = 0 in every analysed read) and the frozen code path treats that as a failed gate, so the delivered verdict is INDETERMINATE (ENTRY_BOOK_RECONSTRUCTION_UNVALIDATED) while the rule's own verdict on the analysed sample is KILL_MATERIALITY.
deviations.cause: The gate was declared before the run with threshold 0.90; nothing about it was changed after the result. Both outcomes are reported.
deviations.effect_on_verdict: reported in full: results.json:decision.rule_verdict = KILL_MATERIALITY, delivered verdict INDETERMINATE with the named clause.

deviations.as_run: The entry deadline (15:59:00 ET) never bound: all 2465 denominator symbols received an eligible entry print, the last of them within seconds of 15:55:00.

25 signal-defined symbols have delta_imbalance == 0 once the frozen sign rule is applied (their direction is B or S but the signed change is zero), so 1286 signal-defined symbols reduce to 1261 analysed.
deviations.cause: the frozen 'zero signal' exclusion, applied before any outcome was computed.
